correctness.rationale: For q odd the sl2 trace form is nondegenerate, and for each nonzero A its adjoint has kernel span(A), rank 2, image A^perp. For Z=[A,C] nonzero, there are q²-1 nonzero A in Z^perp and q solutions C each; [A,C]≠0 forces A,C independent, making (B,D)->[B,C]+[A,D] surjective rank3, hence q³ choices per W and q⁴(q²-1) fiber. For Z=0, except (A,C)=(0,0), every commuting pair is (au,cu) on one projective line with q²-1 nonzero coefficient pairs; the second map has image u^perp and kernel q⁴. A fixed nonzero W has q+1 eligible projective lines, W=0 has q²+q+1, plus q^6 zero-input pairs. This yields all three formulas and summing over q^6 targets returns q^12. The centralizer is 2D when A!=0, 4D when A=0 and B!=0, and 6D at zero, giving rank multiplicities 0:1, 2:q³-1, 4:q³(q³-1). Division by q^12 yields q^-4+q^-5+q^-6-q^-7-q^-8. Direct independent literal enumeration over F3 calculated all 531441 ordered brackets and exactly matched every one of 729 fibers; this finite test is not a proof for all prime-power q.
